title: poink chat
tagline: poink chat is an all in one interface unifying defi and onchain activities across evm chains into a single interface along with a twitter agent for twitter interactions
description: poink chat is an all in one interface unifying defi and onchain activities across evm chains into a single interface, with the best part being the users dont have to leave our platform to interact with the defi ecosystems and further plans to expand to all kinds of interactions directly on a single platform
how_its_made: our project uses autonome for hosting the bot that enables direct interactions on twitter , gaianet for the AI model with eliza and further integrated multiple important ecosystem defi dapps on flow, base and arbitrum to enable seamless interactions with them through our chat interface , with endless possibilities
